purpose: gnssl11b (kernel q10jr11 / 0364): S11 HOLD (K=31, ioctl 171): as gnssl11a but after the boot GNSS stays powered (GPS wake vote HELD, INTEN off, RX 256 B per arming, NOT rolled back until reboot) and the tool reads /dev/gpsdl0 for 20 s, hex-printing and parsing every DSP frame (N2GRPL frame ...). Tool gpu/hwcodec/gnss/probe/n2gpsdl_replay.c installed under the n2gpsdl_step name. Same guest/owned/undo as gnssstep (guest-gnssstep1.sh, owned-gnssstep1.json, payload-gnssstep-undo).
